scope: Demonstrated live-log startup contention with lagging canonical control replay
cause: An initial HTTP slot is a fixed bootstrap number; reaching it after replay does not establish current control. Live logs opened while control was 136 seconds old, and competed with unfinished control replay.
change: Before opening live rolling joins, require the actually sealed durable control receipt to reach the initial tip and satisfy the existing 15-second normal-readiness market-time bound. A later unsealed header is insufficient.
unchanged: Full economic publication and candidate lookbacks
